page.layout: One printed page, 188. Running head: none. Heading block at top (CAP. XVIII. with italic argument title), then "Argumentatio." and "SECT. I.", then one column of running text with an opening woodcut initial Q. No marginal notes. Catchword at lower right. The right edge shows a neighbouring page, which is excluded.

main_text.l: De Condigno Meritorum esse vitæ æternæ, non
Major ex Scripturis facilè evincitur, in quibus
perveniendi ad vitam æternam, sæpe anteponitur
sarios nostros assensuros esse nullùs dubito.

page.notes: The initial Q is a woodcut ornament; the word is Uicquid in print, read here as Quicquid. The catchword "I. Thæ-" has its small capitals rendered as "Thæ-" and is doubtful: [?] would apply to the letters THÆ read from the small caps. Show-through and the neighbouring page at the right edge are excluded. The page is a scan of an old book, so the ink is faint in places; no word in the body is uncertain.
